gotchas: Passive gear. It equalises the charge across two series 12 V batteries in a 24 V bank and has an alarm LED and a relay contact; it has no data port, no radio and no protocol. The retail listing claims none, and the committed BLE record-type table has no entry that could cover it.

It appears in this survey only because one Quebec retailer bundles it with a BMV-712. The bundle is two devices, one of which is a battery monitor on the `victron-bmv71x-smartshunt-vedirect-text` dialect and one of which is this. Do not let the bundle SKU create a phantom model.
The alarm relay contact is reachable as a dry contact on a GPIO input — that is `local-io`, not a Victron dialect, and it is the only route to knowing this device has tripped.
